programs.desc: The Napiers reminisce about a woman who's thrilled to move to Laurel, Miss., and wants a house that reflects her feminine and eclectic style; Ben and Erin present her with options, and they look to bring a bit of Mississippi into the one she chooses.

programs.sub_title: Memory Lane: What's Good for the Goose

programs.title: Home Town
programs.desc: The Napiers recollect helping a man who has turned his life around and now wants to renovate his small guest cottage into a safe haven for those who need it; Ben and Erin's best pals help them take on a massive project Erin has dreamt of for years.

programs.title: Home Town
programs.desc: A restoration enthusiast couple wants to raise their two kids in a historic home in Laurel, and they know they'll need to settle on a fixer-upper; Ben and Erin show them two homes, one with bay windows and another with an enticing porch.

programs.sub_title: From Show Goats to Show Stopper
programs.desc: A couple who are longtime Laurel, Miss., business owners purchase a historic building downtown, and they want to convert the upper level into their residence; Ben and Erin are tasked with turning a gymnasium-like space into a luxurious downtown loft.

programs.title: Home Town
programs.desc: A civil engineer and artist is moving from Seattle to Laurel, Miss., to be closer to his dad; he has a generous budget and an outdoor hot tub is a non-negotiable; Ben and Erin show him two large houses that suit his modern-contemporary vibe.

programs.title: Home Town
programs.desc: A couple decides to move back to their roots in Laurel, Miss.; they're looking for a home with a big lot for outdoor living; Ben and Erin show them a rancher that fits their love of modern rustic design and a home with an enticing in-ground pool.
